steps.title: Submission Forms

audioNote.markdown:
Within your event, a default submission form will already be available for use. If needed, you can create additional forms by clicking the Create Submission Form button. Up to a maximum of 20 forms can be created. For example, you might create one form for internal speakers and another for external speakers, each with its own set of tailored questions.

To begin, click the ellipsis to the right of the available form.

steps.title: Description & Instructions

audioNote.markdown:
There are two required session fields—Title and Description—that must be completed by the submitter and cannot be removed from the form by an admin user. If you’d like these fields to appear under a different label - for example, Session Name instead of the word Title - simply hover over the field and click the pencil icon to edit the label.

You can also add help text by clicking the blue text to the right of the field; this help text will appear beneath the field name in the form.

audioNote.markdown: Within the pop-up, add a field name and specify the field type—whether it’s a dropdown, checkbox, or text box. steps.title: Track

audioNote.markdown:
Click the ellipsis icon to the right of a field to reveal additional actions.



Customize Question allows you to add a field label and help text to your fields. Use Question Rules enables you to apply conditional logic so that questions appear based on responses to previous questions. Edit Fields lets you modify the field description and any additional settings based on the field type—for example, adding or removing options for a dropdown field. Finally, Remove from Form removes the field from the form without deleting it, allowing it to be used again in the future.
